coordinate_projection.distortion: < 0.01% within 50 km trajectory extents in Darmstadt region (~49.85°N, 8.65°E)

features.name: distance_to_segment_m
features.description: Perpendicular / clamped Euclidean distance from the GPS observation point to the candidate directed road segment in metres.
features.missing_value_policy: Imputed directly via spatial index query; zero-candidate observations yield no candidate rows.

features.name: projection_fraction
features.description: Normalized scalar fraction along the directed road segment where the observation projects. 0.0 corresponds to from_node_id, 1.0 corresponds to to_node_id.

features.name: segment_length_m
features.description: Physical metric length of the candidate road segment between its start and end nodes.
features.missing_value_policy: Computed from road network node coordinates; minimum clipped to 1e-3 to avoid division by zero.

features.name: heading_diff_deg
features.description: Absolute angular difference between trajectory heading (vector between consecutive GPS points) and directed road segment bearing. Folded into [0, 180].
features.missing_value_policy: Set to 90.0 degrees (neutral/perpendicular) when vehicle is stationary (speed < 0.5 m/s).

features.name: heading_alignment_cos
features.description: Cosine of heading_diff_deg. +1.0 indicates identical direction, 0.0 perpendicular, -1.0 opposite direction (e.g. wrong way on a one-way street).
features.missing_value_policy: Evaluated as cos(radians(heading_diff_deg)); equals 0.0 when vehicle is stationary.

features.name: gps_speed_mps
features.description: Empirical ground speed computed as spatial_gap_m divided by time_gap_s.
features.missing_value_policy: Forward filled from step 0 to step 1 for first observation t=0.

features.name: time_gap_s
features.description: Time elapsed since previous GPS observation (delta t). Nominally 1.0 s for 1Hz sampling.
features.missing_value_policy: Set to 1.0 s for first observation t=0.

features.name: spatial_gap_m
features.description: Metric Euclidean distance travelled since previous GPS observation.
features.missing_value_policy: Set to 0.0 m for first observation t=0.

features.name: candidate_rank_dist
features.description: Ascending distance rank of this candidate among all candidates for the given observation (0 = nearest candidate).
features.missing_value_policy: Computed deterministically by sorting candidate distances per observation.

features.name: dist_diff_from_nearest_m
features.description: Distance difference between this candidate and the rank-0 (nearest) candidate for the same observation. Identically 0.0 for rank-0.

features.name: speed_length_ratio
features.description: Ratio of distance travelled in current time step (gps_speed_mps * time_gap_s) to the candidate segment length.

features.name: is_zero_speed
features.description: Binary indicator set to 1 if gps_speed_mps < 0.5 m/s (vehicle stopped / idling), 0 otherwise.

features.name: reliability_flag
features.description: Quality flag set to 1 if sampling interval is normal (0.5s <= dt <= 3.0s), vehicle speed is plausible (<= 45 m/s), and candidate distance <= 50m. Set to 0 otherwise.
